name: For the Love of Robots
source:
2247: humans, apes, and robots live in harmony, having mostly abandoned computers.

Tógi was quietly living his life as an elementary school teacher when his friend and partner in crime Valérie invited him to a mixer where he could meet the man of his dreams. What he didn't know is that he (and you) would have to work quite a bit harder to get it than he thought.

[From [url=https://fdrstar.itch.io/for-the-love-of-robots]Itch.io[/url]]
